product_one_liner.value: SiMa.ai combines power-efficient AI chips and development software to help developers and equipment manufacturers build and deploy on-device physical AI applications across robotics, automotive, drones, industrial automation, government, smart vision and healthcare.

pricing_page.notes: Public product pricing appears on the hardware catalog (Modalix DevKit: $1,499) and the Palette Edgematic AWS Marketplace listing; this is not a dedicated /pricing page.

named_customers.notes: The founder and CEO explicitly calls both companies customers, rather than merely partners.

eng_blog.notes: Two technical posts by hardware engineering VP Srivi Dhruvanarayan discuss Modalix architecture, engineering decisions and its TSMC N6 implementation.

public_docs.notes: Public developer documentation covers ModelSDK, compilation, deployment, runtime tools and supported models.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Principal Engineer, AI & ML Design Verification (AI2517), San Jose, is listed among current openings.

model_provider.value: Llama, Gemma, Phi, Qwen and Mistral models from Hugging Face
model_provider.notes: These are publicly documented models compiled and run locally on Modalix using LLiMa; the evidence establishes model execution/support, not a hosted inference API provider.

compliance_certs.notes: The public privacy/legal page names none of SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR or PCI DSS as claimed certifications; this does not establish that the company lacks private certifications.

last_funding.notes: Announced September 28, 2026; co-led by Fidelity Management & Research Company and Amplify.

raised_18mo.notes: The September 28, 2026 Series C falls within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The readable current openings list has no SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative or account executive title.

launched_6mo.notes: Launched Palette Neat, an agentic development environment for Physical AI, on June 16, 2026, within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Young-Hun Kluge announced on March 17, 2026 that he had joined as Senior Vice President, Global Business Development Automotive.

crm_stack_signal.notes: A Sales & Revenue Operations job description explicitly assigns Salesforce CRM management, data hygiene, reporting and forecasting. The posting is closed, so it establishes a stack signal, not a current vacancy; other ERP names are only experience requirements.
